static_traits.name: Chen Ruiqiu
static_traits.family_status: 与姐姐同住，近期关系因其not yet回复礼物致谢而出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: deny既往类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；without显著身体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、条理性较好，能自我Reflection并识do not思维模式；情绪偏Anxiety但配合度高，语气与语速平稳，偶有怀疑态度

basic_info.main_problem: 因姐姐尚not yet对生日礼物表达感谢而感到Anxiety与心烦，担心她not喜欢礼物并认为自己“很抠门/很廉价”。该问题持续占据思绪，影响情绪与日常功能。
basic_info.core_demands: 由于对姐姐not yet回复的Anxiety与担忧not断侵占自己的思绪并影响日常活动，希望通过咨询缓解Anxiety、检验和修正灾难化与跳结论等思维。
growth_experiences: 青少年时期在足球场上常出现Self-doubt与比较同伴的经历：如在练习中一次失误后即Self-denial（“我很糟糕”），负面体验反复出现并在成年后偶尔加重，影响竞技表现与情绪。

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' recognition
I am not good enough/do not人会觉得我很廉价

special_situations.event: 寄出姐姐的生日礼物后not yet收到感谢
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果对方have not及时表达感谢，就说明他们negate我、认为我很廉价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not停关注对方是否回复，在心里为对方找理由（如她可能很忙）以缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她一定讨厌这份礼物，并且觉得我很抠门

special_situations.event: 在向他人表达善意或付出后，have not收到即时的回应或认可
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我的自我价值需要被即时肯定，否则就说明我not被重视
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks external recognition by giving more, sending gifts, or frequently checking messages
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not重视我，我做得很差

special_situations.event: 足球训练中出现一次明显失误
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake equals failure; only a perfect performance counts as passing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-criticism and comparing with peers, tries to force myself to focus on strengths but with limited effect

special_situations.event: When comparing with teammates' performance in the team, finds others performing better
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not比do not人更好，就not值得被认可
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复与他人比较、忽视自身优点与成就

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be promptly recognized and accepted by family and significant others (to be seen, to be affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被忽视、被negate或被视为not重要，从而失去关系亲密感
defense_goal: Maintains secure relationships and a sense of self-worth by giving to others and seeking immediate feedback
在not yet获回应时以Rationalization与自我安抚来降低Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: Anxiety的取悦者/需要被认可的人
object_relations.object_representation: 可能挑剔或轻视自己的他者（如姐姐）

object_relations.self_representation: 自卑的队员、容易因失误Self-denial的个体
object_relations.object_representation: 更优秀且带有评判性的队友/他者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当向重要他人表达善意而not yet获及时回应或认可时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的沉默理解为对自己的negate与轻视（认为他人not重视自己）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、理性化的语言为对方找理由（如“她可能很忙”），语气平稳，降低情绪强度，避免直接表达受伤感。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: A mistake occurs during training or competition; worried about others' evaluation
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身的not安Projection到他人，推断他人会轻视或negate自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoids directly acknowledging vulnerability, instead describing others' possible thoughts and attitudes; uses cautious, indirect wording, maintaining a distance from the emotions.

manifestations: 在not yet获得他人（尤其家人）即时回应时体验到强烈的被忽视与not被看见感
自我价值高度依赖他人反馈与认可

contact_model.definition: 个体克制想对外做出的行为冲动，或放弃向外寻求他人为其做某事，转而对自己做，即将原欲对外发出的能量Turning against the self。
manifestations: 在现实生活中not向朋友表达Anxiety与需求，选择把担忧压在自己身上
会谈中对记录积极事件持怀疑与自我限制态度，倾向Self-denial而非向外寻求支持

exception_events.target_problem: 在足球训练或比赛中，一旦出现失误，来访者通常会立即Self-denial，情绪下滑并影响后续表现
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上个月在比赛中完成一次制胜传球，获得队友的欢呼与肯定，当下体验到归属感与自信，与以往失误后持续低迷not同
exception_events.reason: not同支持与情境：当时团队氛围积极、获得队友正向反馈；做法not同：更专注于比赛当下并回忆以往成功经验，因此这一刻能维持表现与自信

positive_force: Willing to seek professional help and cooperate with counseling
Can recall and acknowledge her own positive performance (such as a winning pass)
Has some willingness for reality testing (will remind oneself the other party may be busy)
存在基础社会支持（有朋友可谈日常）
negative_force: 强烈的外部认可依赖倾向
灾难化、读心术与非黑即白思维频繁出现
过度比较导致自我价值波动
Anxiety影响睡眠与专注，Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: 在not yet获即时回应时出现Significant anxiety与反复猜测他人看法（伴随反复查看消息与走神）
antecedent: 向他人（尤其姐姐）表达善意或付出后not yet收到及时感谢或回应
期待被认可的情境中出现沉默或延迟反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessively binds self-worth to others' immediate approval, with cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing and mind reading
target_behavior.function: 通过寻求外部认同来短暂缓解not确定性与Anxiety；或通过回避面对内在not安来降低情绪痛苦
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪困扰显著、睡眠与Impaired concentration、Decline in work performance、与姐姐Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 在训练或比赛中因一次失误产生强烈Self-denial，随之表现下降
antecedent: 足球练习或比赛中出现一次明显失误
与队友的表现进行比较
target_behavior.core_reason: Cognitive tendencies toward black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization，将一次错误等同于整体失败；自我评价高度受他人表现影响
target_behavior.function: 试图通过自我苛责来激励改进或避免再次犯错（实际加重Anxiety与抑制表现）
target_behavior.consequence: Competitive state fluctuates, negative emotions spill over into areas of life, further weakening confidence and team interaction
